title: Surreal Rabbit Vision
description: A large brown rabbit with a swirling rainbow shell emerges from golden sand dunes, holding a red 'NO ENTRY' sign. Above it floats a disembodied man's worried face with radiating lines against a cracked black sky, while four silhouetted African women with headwraps and floral adornments stand below among white flowers.
prompt: Surreal symbolic artwork featuring a giant brown rabbit with a colorful spiral shell emerging from sand dunes, holding a red octagonal NO ENTRY sign. A disembodied worried man's head floats above with radiating light rays against a cracked black sky. In the foreground, four silhouetted African women wearing headwraps and traditional jewelry stand among flowers and foliage. Dramatic contrast, vibrant accents, painterly style with visible brushwork.
